dedupe_keys.name: transtools 3 trans tools european transport network model

description: TransTools 3 (TT3) is the European transport demand and network model that upgraded the earlier TRANS-TOOLS versions; it was finalised and delivered to the European Commission in 2017 by a consortium of the Technical University of Denmark and Rapidis ApS. It is aimed mainly at investigating and benchmarking large-scale EU projects. It has three main sub-models: passenger demand, with short-distance (under 100 km) and long-distance models covering all trip purposes, mode, destination and frequency choice across 42 European countries and links to the rest of the world; freight demand, with a trade model giving production-consumption matrices and a logistics model giving flows by mode and commodity; and assignment for passengers and freight, iterated with demand to equilibrium so that congestion is internalised. Access: the model runs on Windows 10 with ArcGIS for Desktop (Basic, with Network Analyst), Microsoft SQL Server 2014 and Rapidis Traffic Analyst; Rapidis offers software and installation assistance for a price on request. Caveats: it depends on commercial software and is built for aggregate European analysis, not local detail. It supports network flow, capacity planning and investment appraisal studies of European corridors, and complements Samgods and the TEN-T network data catalogued here.
